Introduction

Jung Jaehyun, best known by his stage name Jaehyun, is a member of the South Korean boy group NCT. He is the lead dancer, main vocalist, and lead rapper of its sub-units NCT U and NCT 127.

Born as Jung Jae Hyun on February 14th, 1997. Aside from singing and dancing, Jaehyun can also play the piano. Moreover, he used to be the DJ for the NCT Night Night radio show along with Johnny.

Jaehyun, along with his fellow members Doyoung and Jungwoo, debuted in the sub-unit NCT DOJAEJUNG with their first EP, Perfume, on April 17, 2023. Jaehyun is the Main Vocalist, Lead Dancer, and Visual of the group.

Jaehyun had his official solo debut on August 26, 2024, with the release of his first full-length studio album, J.

Jaehyun enlisted in the South Korean military on November 4, 2024, to serve as an active-duty soldier in the Army Band. He is expected to be dicharged by May 3, 2026.
